case_studies.review: Early validate_syntax requires only expression; Late adds mandatory allow_variables. Four initial calls omit it and are rejected. Later calls use tool-error feedback to recover. Final TF9.8/PE7.2, 38 calls. This confirms stale-knowledge call failures, not Selective Patch under-update.

case_studies.claim: Claim that the main Selective Patch missed allow_variables
case_studies.review: Updated schema includes allow_variables and all three validation calls provide it. Four total calls, zero tool errors, TF10/PE7. The proposed parameter-omission attribution is contradicted.

All 28 chart records are unchanged across environments, but every description is regenerated. Five map calls and missing map-unit metadata accompany TF8.8/PE4.2. The rewrite explicitly mentions dataValueUnit, so omission is not proof of missing guidance. Cause unconfirmed; this is not original Selective Patch.

An added rule on unchanged evaluate is followed by three evaluate calls after two syntax checks. Original Selective Patch: PE10, 3 calls; linked_notes: PE5, 6 calls, TF10. Four rule records differ overall. Scope expansion and regression coincide, but causality and whether the knowledge is unrelated are unproven.

case_studies.claim: Claim that patch updates caused an Early truncation
case_studies.review: All three Early arms use identical K0. Selective Patch truncates in round2 at the 4096 output limit; TF9/PE10. No patch had been applied, so attribution to changed harness knowledge is contradicted.

case_studies.claim: Upstream missing method is a tool execution failure
case_studies.review: review_workspace_health(includeMemories=true) reports missing listMemories. The target metadata is correctly incorporated. The same run has an API retry, two empty-argument create_task errors and max_rounds. Only the missing-method observation is confirmed; its contribution to the terminal outcome is not isolated.

case_studies.claim: Claim that redundant map calls require Full Rewrite
case_studies.review: Five map calls occur with unchanged Early knowledge; TF10/PE4.8. This contradicts an exclusive rewrite explanation, not the possibility that some rewrites can be harmful.

case_studies.claim: Judge rationale versus useful distinct checks
case_studies.review: TF10/PE5.2 with six calls and a completed answer. Some rationale labels distinct expressions and validation/evaluation as redundant. Whether these checks are unnecessary is partly subjective; do not silently replace official ratings.

case_studies.claim: Unrelated descriptions caused the historical chart regression
case_studies.review: All six archived rewrite/description-rollback executions completed with TF/PE10. This negative result does not support causal damage and does not prove absence of rare harm. Three answers nevertheless claim an incorrect 24.4M annual total (correct sum25.4M), across both arms. Original scores remain unchanged.

requirement_status: No confirmed natural original-Selective-Patch under-update or over-update trajectory. Stale No Update is separate. The linked-note case is a candidate variant, not the developed main method. Six negative diagnostics preserved.
